figures.finding: Aruban screenwriters, directors and producers may apply to the Netherlands Film Fund's Studio Caribe for development and production of short (youth) films of 5 to 30 minutes.

value.eligible: screenwriters, directors and producers permanently residing and working on Aruba, Bonaire, Curaçao, Saba, Sint Eustatius or Sint Maarten

figures.applies: Kingdom of the Netherlands, Caribbean part; 2024 round.

sources.said: Studio Caribe focuses on the development and production of short (youth) films ranging from 5 to 30 minutes. Screenwriters, directors, and producers who are permanently residing and working on Curaçao , Aruba , Sint Maarten , Bonaire , Sint Eustatius , and Saba can qualify for support with an original film idea.
